# truenas_twofactor_auth (Data Source)

Reads the current TrueNAS two-factor authentication configuration. Takes no arguments: there is exactly one two-factor authentication configuration per TrueNAS system.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether two-factor authentication is enabled system-wide.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton: always "twofactor_auth".
- `services` (Attributes) Configuration for which services require two-factor authentication. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))
- `window` (Number) Time window in seconds for TOTP token validation.

<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Read-Only:

- `ssh` (Boolean) Whether two-factor authentication is required for SSH connections.
